system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

Case: AURORA NCT00240331 - AURORA: Crestor 10mg Versus Placebo in Subjects With End-stage Renal Disease (ESRD) | mode: autopsy | as_of: 2009-03-30
Drug: rosuvastatin (HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor)

Verdict: {"outcome": "failure", "outcome_basis": "readout: \"During a median follow-up period of 3.8 years, 396 patients in the rosuvastatin group and 408 in the placebo group reached the primary end p\" (announcement:aurora)", "predicted_outcome": "success", "consistency": "calculator expected success with 77% probability; the actual result falls in the remaining 23%", "primary_category": "population", "secondary_categories": ["design_or_endpoint"], "calculator_category": "narrow_success", "confidence": "high", "verification": "done", "probability_of_success": 0.773, "weakest_link": "target genetics: uncertain"}
Calculator: {"case_id": "aurora", "ldl_equivalent_mmol": 0.9, "basis": "LDL-C", "time_factor": 0.854, "expected_hr": 0.826, "causal_rrr": 0.174, "bp_factor": 1.0, "power": 0.773, "mde_hr_80": 0.821, "outcome": "success", "category": "narrow_success", "secondary": [], "weakest_link": "target genetics: uncertain", "consistent_with_observed": null, "assumptions": ["LDL-C: no baseline given, assumed 2.0"], "notes": []}
Hypotheses: {"hypotheses": [{"category": "population", "status": "supported", "for": [{"text": "ESRD patients on hemodialysis have CV events driven largely by non-atherosclerotic mechanisms (sudden cardiac death, arrhythmia, vascular calcification, heart failure) that LDL lowering does not prevent.", "refs": ["f_7383925506be99", "f_114a306b671b29"]}, {"text": "CORONA trial (rosuvastatin 10mg in systolic heart failure) also showed null result for primary endpoint, supporting that populations with advanced non-atherosclerotic CV disease do not benefit from LDL lowering.", "refs": ["f_bb593bb54c370c"]}], "against": [{"text": "The primary endpoint includes nonfatal MI and stroke which are atherosclerotic; LDL lowering should prevent some of these events.", "refs": ["f_114a306b671b29"]}], "would_settle": "Cause-specific event breakdown in AURORA (CV death subtypes, MI, stroke rates separately) to quantify atherosclerotic vs non-atherosclerotic event proportions."}, {"category": "design_or_endpoint", "status": "supported", "for": [{"text": "The composite endpoint includes CV death, which in ESRD is predominantly sudden cardiac death/arrhythmia not prevented by LDL lowering; this dilutes any benefit on atherosclerotic events (MI, stroke).", "refs": ["f_114a306b671b29", "f_7383925506be99"]}], "against": [{"text": "Standard MACE endpoint used in many statin trials that were positive; the issue is population-specific event composition, not endpoint design per se.", "refs": ["f_114a306b671b29"]}], "would_settle": "Component-specific HRs for MI, stroke, and CV death subtypes in AURORA."}, {"category": "biomarker_not_causal", "status": "weakened", "for": [{"text": "Observed HR~1.0 (p=0.59) with 804 total events excludes predicted HR 0.826 (95% CI ~0.84-1.12) despite adequate power (77%) and biomarker change assumption.", "refs": ["f_a75061c6f3526a", "f_9353f8733ad3dd", "f_9d4bc6d9320487", "calculator"]}], "against": [{"text": "LDL-C is well-established causal for atherosclerosis; the failure is likely due to population-specific pathophysiology (non-atherosclerotic events dominating) not biomarker non-causality per se. CORONA (heart failure) also null despite LDL lowering.", "refs": ["f_bb593bb54c370c", "f_fccd28530bc97f"]}], "would_settle": "Mendelian randomization in ESRD populations; component-specific analysis showing LDL-C lowering reduces MI/stroke but not sudden death."}, {"category": "effect_too_small", "status": "weakened", "for": [{"text": "Calculator predicted HR 0.826, MDE 0.821 for 80% power; trial had 77% power - close to threshold.", "refs": ["calculator"]}], "against": [{"text": "Observed HR~1.0 with p=0.59 and 804 events yields 95% CI excluding 0.826; not a power issue but a true null effect. The effect isn't too small to detect - it's absent.", "refs": ["f_a75061c6f3526a", "calculator"]}], "would_settle": "N/A - data already excludes predicted effect."}, {"category": "off_target_harm", "status": "weakened", "for": [], "against": [{"text": "No evidence of harm offsetting benefit; safety signals show similar adverse event rates between groups.", "refs": ["f_48035d202aa3e8"]}], "would_settle": "N/A."}, {"category": "target_not_causal", "status": "weakened", "for": [{"text": "HMGCR genetics score 0.695 but evidence_before_cutoff=0 (uncertain).", "refs": ["f_371d4f07f55da0"]}], "against": [{"text": "HMGCR is validated target; statins work in general population. Genetics uncertainty is about evidence before cutoff, not target validity.", "refs": ["f_371d4f07f55da0"]}], "would_settle": "N/A."}, {"category": "execution_or_nonscientific", "status": "weakened", "for": [], "against": [{"text": "Trial completed as planned with 2750 patients and 3.8 years median follow-up.", "refs": ["f_e13f24dde6c1e0", "f_0d92f6cffd0e4a"]}], "would_settle": "N/A."}, {"category": "insufficient_data", "status": "weakened", "for": [{"text": "No AURORA-specific LDL-C change or baseline LDL-C in verified facts; calculator used CORONA surrogate and assumed baseline 2.0 mmol/L.", "refs": ["calculator", "f_fccd28530bc97f"]}], "against": [{"text": "Key outcome data (events, p-value, follow-up) are available; the null result is clear regardless of exact LDL-C magnitude.", "refs": ["f_a75061c6f3526a", "f_9353f8733ad3dd", "f_9d4bc6d9320487"]}], "would_settle": "AURORA-specific LDL-C levels and on-treatment changes."}], "primary_category": "population", "secondary_categories": ["design_or_endpoint"], "confidence": "high", "departure_from_calculator": "Calculator categorized 'narrow_success' (predicted HR 0.826, power 77%) but actual outcome is failure (HR~1.0, p=0.59). The calculator used CORONA trial LDL-C change (-45%) as surrogate for AURORA and assumed the CTT meta-analysis relationship holds in ESRD. However, the observed HR~1.0 with 804 events yields 95% CI (~0.84-1.12) that excludes the predicted 0.826. The departure is explained by population-specific pathophysiology: in ESRD on hemodialysis, most CV events arise from non-atherosclerotic mechanisms (sudden cardiac death, arrhythmia, vascular calcification) that LDL lowering does not prevent, a pattern also seen in the CORONA heart failure trial."}
